definitions.gloss: city council; city assembly; the elected legislative body of a Japanese city
definitions.explanation: The elected legislative body of a Japanese {市|し} (city). City council members ({市議会|しぎかい}{議員|ぎいん}) debate local ordinances, approve the city's budget, and oversee the mayor's administration. Parallel bodies exist at other levels: {町議会|ちょうぎかい} for towns and {県議会|けんぎかい} for prefectures.

examples.japanese: {市議会|しぎかい}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: The city council session has begun.

examples.japanese: {市議会|しぎかい}{議員|ぎいん}の{選挙|せんきょ}が{来月|らいげつ}{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: The city council election will be held next month.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{条例|じょうれい}は{市議会|しぎかい}で{可決|かけつ}されて{来年|らいねん}から{施行|しこう}される。
examples.english: The new ordinance was passed by the city council and will take effect next year.

notes:
Composed of {市|し} (city) and {議会|ぎかい} (assembly, council). Each Japanese city has its own {市議会|しぎかい}, with the number of seats roughly proportional to population. Council members serve four-year terms and work alongside — and often in tension with — the separately elected {市長|しちょう} (mayor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市議会|しぎかい}{議員|ぎいん}: city council member
- {市議会|しぎかい}{選挙|せんきょ}: city council election
- {市議会|しぎかい}で{可決|かけつ}する: to be passed by the city council
- {市議会|しぎかい}で{否決|ひけつ}する: to be rejected by the city council
- {市議会|しぎかい}{議長|ぎちょう}: chairperson of the city council

RELATED WORDS:
- {議会|ぎかい}: assembly, legislature (the general term at any level)
- {町議会|ちょうぎかい}: town council (for a {町|まち}, a smaller municipality)
- {村議会|そんぎかい}: village council
- {区議会|くぎかい}: ward council (for the 23 special wards of Tokyo)
- {県議会|けんぎかい}: prefectural assembly
- {国会|こっかい}: National Diet (the national parliament)
